detail.longDescription: Every attacker request returned 403, and the domain was hijacked anyway. Tenet Security's GhostJacking: Cloudflare's WAF blocks the request but logs its User-Agent byte-for-byte. An agent triaging blocked traffic reads that field, then patches DNS via a second MCP in the same session. 90% success on Claude Code. A block log is attacker-authored text. Keep write tools away from it. https:// tenetsecurity.ai/blog/ghostjac king-attacks-agentic-kill-chain/ # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # MCP
